description: MELDATA publishes district-level agricultural statistics collected for Supporting Coordination and Cooperation in Water Management in the Euphrates and Tigris Area. Coverage includes Syria, Iraq and Turkey and three reporting years: 2002, 2006 and 2008. Fields describe the four major crops, cultivated area in hectares, season, irrigated/rainfed/supplemental classification, irrigation-water source, planting and harvesting periods, crop intensity, rotation, yield and market price. This explicit water-management application supports use as irrigation-demand context. The source does not claim measured withdrawals, network capacity or a complete basin water balance. One CSV data table and three CSV data dictionaries are listed. District completeness and field definitions remain unverified. Access: the native repository lists public files and free access under CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: no dataset files were downloaded; actual contents, completeness and numerical quality were not checked. Related resources are linked through the MELDATA parent collection.
